description: This file defines the Alignment class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, responsible for parsing XML style attributes related to cell alignment, including vertical and horizontal alignment, text wrapping, and rotation.

classes.name: Alignment
classes.description: Parses XML style attributes related to cell alignment in the PhpSpreadsheet library.

methods.name: parseStyle
methods.description: Parses the provided SimpleXMLElement containing style attributes and returns an array with alignment styles such as vertical, horizontal, wrapText, and rotation.
